description: Add days spent in a country to the signed-in member's residency tracker. Writes to their real record, so confirm the country and the exact dates with them first and never infer dates. Days already logged are kept (their kind and note are updated when given).

day_kind.description: How the day counts. Defaults to present.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to log a single day.

notes.description: Optional note stored against the days.

name: log_residency_days
title: Log residency days
